Hunt Royale: Action RPG Battle is a RPG mobile game developed and published by Polish developer Boombit released in 2021.
It's base gameplay is a simple 4 player last man standing where you kill monsters to get XP and level up. The winner is the player with the most XP or the last survivor.
The game has expanded significantly from that original game mode over the past 3 years adding both competitive and cooperative modes such as dungeons that utilize gear and teamwork to defeat the dungeons and a horde mode where you are swarmed by zombies for as long as you can survive.
